newsitem.title: USA: BellSouth, U.S. Cellular to swap clusters.
newsitem.headline: BellSouth, U.S. Cellular to swap clusters.

text.p: United States Cellular Corp on Tuesday said it has entered an agreement with BellSouth Corp to exchange cellular clusters.

Under the agreement, U.S. Cellular will receive controlling interest in a 12-market cluster that provides cellular service to most of Wisconsin, including the Milwaukee market, and parts of northern Illinois, U.S. Cellular said.

In exchange, BellSouth will receive a nine-market cluster in southern Indiana and Kentucky, a controlling interest in one market in central Tennessee, investment interest in 13 other markets and an undisclosed amount of cash, U.S. Cellular said.
